newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: DSC to set up 17 mln punt Irish plant.
newsitem.headline: DSC to set up 17 mln punt Irish plant.

text.p: U.S. firm DSC Communication Corp is to set up a 17-million-punt operation in Drogheda, Ireland, creating 475 jobs within the next four years, Irish enterprise and employment minister Richard Bruton said on Wednesday.
State industrial development agency IDA Ireland is providing financial assistance for the project, Bruton said in a statement.

"The Drogheda operation is designed to provide software development, procurement and complex technical support to DSC's sales and service centres in Europe, in addition to its manufacturing operations," Bruton said.
The plant would provide significant linkages for Irish suppliers of printed circuit boards, electronic assemblies, cables, wires and metal fabrication, he said.
Bruton said DSC would be locating in a building previously set aside for U.S firm APC Corp, which announced plans last year to create 300 jobs in Drogheda.

"The APC investment as originally announced has been delayed and is currently being revised and renegotiated," he said. "Rather than losing the opportunity of a top-quality investment for Drogheda, IDA Ireland has agreed to this new deal, signed today, with DSC," he said.
